task_description: Build a complete, production-ready website called BrainFog.mov - an AI video generation platform for creating brainrot-style short-form videos. Includes landing page, pricing, auth, dashboard with video generation using Replicate API, and settings. Built with Next.js 14+, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, deployable on Vercel free tier.

verification.summary: npm run build succeeds with all 13 routes (static and dynamic). npm run lint passes cleanly. Review fixes applied: auth on API routes, bcrypt password hashing, localStorage history cap, Replicate constants extraction, server-side rate limit TODO.
